name: Wellington
summary: Wellington, the capital of New Zealand, combines a vibrant cultural and food scene with spectacular nature just minutes from the city centre. It is one of the safest cities in the world, with excellent internet connectivity and a growing technology community. The main drawback is its extreme geographical isolation, which makes international flights more expensive and complicates time zones with Europe or the US, in addition to a considerable cost of living and a windy and changeable climate.
